text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, while talking with Mejiro<n>Dober in my
office...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to interrupt your discussion,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I come bearing good news for you<n>two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good news?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, because of how well you<n>did during
your junior year...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You've been selected by the URA as<n>Best Junior
Year Goddess!<n>Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The title of Goddess is awarded to<n>those who run in
races like the<n>Hanshin J.F., Triple Tiara, and Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The accolade is awarded to one racer<n>in each year:
junior, classic, and<n>senior. It's a huge honor for
Mejiro<n>Dober to be selected to represent her<n>year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I was chosen as Goddess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! ♪ The award<n>ceremony is going to
be held in a few<n>days, so don't forget to prepare a
speech!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's a ceremony?! And I have<n>to give a
speech?! I-I see, um... okay...
choice_data_list: We'll have to make sure you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I know! I'm not going to get up there<n>without
practicing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... I'll make sure to practice a<n>lot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the award ceremony<n>arrives in the blink
of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the award ceremony<n>arrives in the blink
of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(It's going to be fine. I've practiced<n>like a hundred
times. Everything will<n>be fine...)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's hear a word from this<n>year's
junior-year Goddess, Mejiro<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is immediately met with<n>a flood of
well-wishes and applause,<n>as well as flashes from
countless<n>cameras.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... My mind's gone blank.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Something seems off. It looks like<n>stage fright has
gotten her tongue all<n>tied!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Desperate to help however I can, I<n>start wildly
waving my hands in her<n>direction!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Huh? It's Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(What is he making that desperate<n>face for? Idiot.
He's going to make<n>me laugh.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(She looks so desperate, a far cry<n>from her usual
gorgeous face. Heh... I<n>think that did the trick!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I, um... I'd like to express my deepest<n>gratitude to
everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I, um... I'd like to express my deepest<n>gratitude to
everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm elated beyond words at having<n>received such a
magnificent award...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Cut it with the flattery. I completely<n>forgot my
speech and just blurted out<n>whatever came to mind
up there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hardly... I forgot everything I'd<n>prepared and just
rambled endlessly<n>up there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But geez, you looked hilarious<n>from the
stage. You were freaking out<n>so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I saw you waving, you know?<n>You looked so
frantic and silly, I<n>couldn't help smiling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway... Thanks for having my<n>back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I couldn't have<n>done it without
you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I hear her speech was<n>well received by
fans for being so<n>sincere despite its brevity.
